what: The center title section stays pinned while cards sweep past one by one — each card comes to the center from a spot 1.2 screens to the right, 120px down and tilted 10°, stands upright, then leaves tilting to −10° toward a spot 1.2 screens to the left and 120px down (pivot at bottom-center, no curve). The next card starts .4 later, the first card starts already .6 in, and the last card exits only .6 and stops. Pin distance is card count × 100% screen, scrub 1

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Passing card — stacked at the center of the section (the section needs position: relative and a height)
options.gap: Start gap between cards (1 is the distance one card travels), default .4
options.lead: How far the first card has already arrived, default .6
options.tail: How far the last card exits, default .6
options.x: Distance shifted aside (multiple of screen width), default 1.2
options.from: Minimum width to turn on (px), default 992 — below that the cards stack in order
